ruleset.name: PHPMD rules for qtype_ddmatch
ruleset.description:
Moodle's default moodle-plugin-ci PHPMD ruleset (see https://github.com/moodlehq/moodle-plugin-ci/blob/master/res/config/phpmd.xml), with five rules disabled plugin-wide. Every current violation of these rules in this codebase is a confirmed false positive - either an overridden Moodle base-class method or fixed core callback signature that can't be changed without breaking the plugin, or a file whose length/complexity is inherent to its nature (upgrade.php's one-block- per-version convention, or a linear walkthrough test replaying a full attempt step by step). Each site is also documented in-place in the source file it applies to.
moodle-plugin-ci's phpmd command calls the PHPMD API directly rather than the phpmd CLI, and does not read a ruleset's exclude-pattern elements (it hardcodes an empty ignore-list), so file-specific exclusion isn't reachable through it - only a full rule disable is. Inline SuppressWarnings annotations aren't an alternative either: moodle-cs's ValidTagsSniff rejects that tag outright, and phpcs (unlike phpmd) is a hard CI gate.
